final: WITH large_by_purpose AS (SELECT k_symbol, AVG(amount) as avg_amount FROM `order` WHERE amount >= 2802 GROUP BY k_symbol), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as overall_avg FROM large_by_purpose) SELECT lbp.k_symbol, lbp.avg_amount, lbp.avg_amount - overall.overall_avg as excess FROM large_by_purpose lbp, overall WHERE lbp.avg_amount > overall.overall_avg ORDER BY lbp.k_symbol
